description: This source file defines the `ImageManagementServices` class, which provides services related to image upload, scaling, thumbnail creation, renaming, and deletion within the OFBiz framework. The class handles operations like uploading multiple images for a product, resizing images, managing image content and data resources, creating thumbnails, and updating image references.

classes.name: ImageManagementServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for managing product images including upload, resize, thumbnail generation, content and data resource management, renaming, and deletion within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: addMultipleuploadForProduct
methods.description: Handles uploading multiple images for a product, supports image resizing and thumbnail creation, and associates images with product content.

methods.name: removeImageFileForImageManagement
methods.description: Deletes an image file associated with a product's content, given the product ID and content identifiers.

methods.name: scaleImageMangementInAllSize
methods.description: Scales an original image into multiple sizes based on predefined or specified resize types, storing scaled images in the server path.

methods.name: createContentAndDataResource
methods.description: Creates a data resource and updates content with image information, linking images to content entities.

methods.name: createContentThumbnail
methods.description: Generates a thumbnail content record and saves the thumbnail image to the server, associating it with the original image.

methods.name: resizeImageThumbnail
methods.description: Resizes an existing image to generate a thumbnail-sized version, updating associated content and data resources.

methods.name: resizeImageOfProduct
methods.description: Resizes a product image to specified dimensions, overwriting or creating a new image file.

methods.name: renameImage
methods.description: Renames an existing product image, updating related content and data resource references, and managing associated thumbnails.
